actors.name: Bill
actors.private_context: Bill believes the fence is shared property and the Osei family should pay half the repair cost. He is willing to negotiate but will consider small claims if no agreement is reached.

actors.name: Osei family
actors.private_context: The Osei family believes the fence is Bill's responsibility or that they should pay less than half. They prefer to avoid court but are firm on their position.

shared_context: A shared fence between Bill's property and the Osei family's property was damaged by a storm. The fence needs repair. Both parties have discussed the issue but have not yet agreed on how to split the cost. They have two months to reach an agreement before the option of small claims court becomes more likely.

starting_events.description: Bill and the Osei family are aware of the fence damage and have had initial discussions about cost sharing, but no agreement has been reached.

resolution: Resolve YES if, before the cutoff, the persistent event history shows that Bill and the Osei family have both agreed to a specific cost split (e.g., 50-50 or another proportion) and have communicated that agreement to each other. Resolve NO if no such agreement is recorded by the cutoff.
